## A flowchart

Mermaid turns text into diagrams. The executable `{mermaid}` fence below
is handled by Quarto; it does not need Python or R.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-workflow
%%| fig-cap: "A small document review workflow."
flowchart LR
    A[Write a draft] --> B[Preview]
    B --> C{Ready to share?}
    C -->|No| A
    C -->|Yes| D[Render HTML]
```

@fig-workflow includes a decision and a loop. Try adding a review step
before rendering.

## A sequence diagram

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-preview
%%| fig-cap: "What happens during a local preview."
sequenceDiagram
    participant Author
    participant Quarto
    participant Browser
    Author->>Quarto: quarto preview 05-diagrams.qmd
    Quarto->>Browser: Serve rendered document
    Author->>Quarto: Save source changes
    Quarto->>Browser: Refresh preview
```

Use a flowchart for decisions and a sequence diagram for interactions over time.
This example targets HTML; PDF or Word diagram rendering may require additional
tools. See the [diagram guide](https://quarto.org/docs/authoring/diagrams.html).
